tagline: Sora steps into the arena, MikoMari goes streetwear, and Dokibird is booked for Birmingham — but somehow the most-watched story of the week is still three words on a profile page.
inThisIssue: Tokino Sora's 9th debut anniversary: first arena concert announced at Pia Arena MM, November 7
MikoMari x XRAGE streetwear collection drops September 9 in Taiwan and Hong Kong
NIJISANJI Master Duel Festival 2026 opens September 3 with 24 new secret packs

lead.title: Tokino Sora turns nine today and announces her first arena show: 9th Anniversary Party at Pia Arena MM, November 7 — two performances, live band, twelve thousand seats
lead.body: Tokino Sora debuted on September 7, 2017. Nine years later to the day, COVER Corporation announced the Tokino Sora 9th Anniversary Party: Everyday of Light at Pia Arena MM in Yokohama's Minato Mirai district on November 7, 2026. The concert runs twice in a single day: a Sunlight Stage with doors at 13:00 and show at 14:00, followed by a Moonlight Stage with doors at 17:30 and show at 18:30. Both performances feature a live band. Streaming runs November 7 through December 12, 2026, with archive access for approximately one month after the stream opens. Tickets for in-person and streaming are sold separately via eplus. Pia Arena MM holds approximately 12,000 people. Sora's previous anniversary shows have been in smaller dedicated concert venues; an arena date with a live band at this scale is a substantive step up in production tier. The nine-year context matters more than it sounds: most active VTubers debuted after 2019, and Sora's September 7, 2017 debut predates hololive's formal corporate structure. She has been at this longer than most of the industry has existed. November 7 is eleven weeks out.

stories.title: XRAGE x hololive: Sakura Miko and Houshou Marine's MikoMari Collaboration Collection arrives September 9
stories.blurb: COVER Corporation and apparel brand XRAGE announced the MikoMari Collaboration Collection on September 1. The line brings Sakura Miko and Houshou Marine's aesthetics into a full apparel range: a tactical bag, happi coat, and graphic T-shirts with design elements drawn from both talents' color palettes and character motifs. The collection launches September 9 at 6:00 PM CST through XRAGE's official website and select physical stores in Taiwan and Hong Kong. XRAGE is a streetwear label with an established East Asian retail footprint; the MikoMari pairing gets their first co-branded clothing line together. This is hololive's third Taiwan-anchored retail activation of the summer, following the Kenting Travel Diary pop-up in August and the Sunright Tea collab on the US West Coast.

stories.title: Nijisanji Master Duel Festival 2026 is live: 24 secret packs unlocked, Liver tournament streams incoming through October 6
stories.blurb: The NIJISANJI x Yu-Gi-Oh! Master Duel Festival 2026 campaign launched September 3 post-maintenance and runs through October 6 at 12:59 JST. Twenty-four Secret Packs are unlocked in the in-game Shop, each with a free pack pull available. New Secret Packs this year cover Mitsurugi, Maliss, Yummy, and Magnet Warrior strategies. A Commemorative Token campaign runs simultaneously in Japan. The Master Duel Festival has become a reliable annual fixture: it pulls Livers into competitive Yu-Gi-Oh! content for a month, creates natural collab scheduling, and drops ANYCOLOR-branded content in front of Konami's player base at the same time. Tournament streams are still ahead in the schedule.

stories.title: Phase Saga turns one in seven weeks: four members active, two open roster slots, and October 25 speculation already live
stories.blurb: Phase Connect's fourth generation, Phase Saga, debuted October 25, 2025. The one-year anniversary lands October 25, 2026 — seven weeks from today. Four of the original six members remain active; two graduated in the year's first half citing management disagreements. Phase Connect ran a Saga Half Year merchandise drop in April 2026 and marked the agency's fifth anniversary in June without a Saga-specific new wave announcement. Nothing is confirmed for the one-year date, but October has historically corresponded with Phase Connect's larger announcements, the summer convention circuit is done, and the community speculation threads are already running.

stories.title: VeXpo 2026 at Birmingham NEC is two weeks out: Dokibird headlines the opening concert as Europe's biggest VTuber convention enters year three
stories.blurb: VeXpo 2026 runs September 18 through 20 at the National Exhibition Centre in Birmingham, UK. The opening night concert on September 18 is headlined by Dokibird and Dooby, with rachie, ChromaSHIFT, Akugaki Koa, Glitch Stars, and a full bill of English-language indie and small-agency creators across the programme. Anticipated attendance is around 2,200 across three days with approximately 120 guests. The convention is also screening the hololive English 3rd concert -All For One- at the venue during the weekend. VeXpo launched in 2023 as the first VTuber-focused convention in Europe; the NEC Birmingham venue is the largest capacity the event has used. Dokibird headlining the opening night is her first major European convention appearance since going independent.

stories.title: Filian: fourteen weeks past the zeroed countdown — DEBUT DELAYED, no Phase 2 trigger, Phase Connect theory is now the consensus read on /vt/
stories.blurb: Today marks fourteen weeks since Filian's countdown site hit zero. The X account @Filian_VT1 still reads DEBUT DELAYED. Phase 1 — The Wall, the collaborative canvas that opened post-countdown — has been live for months with no Phase 2 trigger surfacing publicly. The current dominant theory on /vt/ frames Filian as Phase Connect-bound: the math of Phase Saga's one-year anniversary on October 25, two open roster slots from graduated members, and Pippa's on-stream comments all pointing in that direction. The counter-camp holds that Filian has publicly committed to staying indie before and that Pippa runs parasocial bits as content regardless of what's real. No official announcement from either side. Fourteen weeks.

indieSubhead: NO AGENCY, NO PROBLEM — NEWS FROM THE SELF-MADE CORNER OF THE SCENE

indies.title: Dokibird headlines VeXpo 2026 opening night: the English indie top tier gets its first European convention headline slot
indies.blurb: Dokibird headlining VeXpo's opening concert at NEC Birmingham on September 18 is the first time a creator from the current English-language indie top tier has headlined a major European VTuber convention. The rest of the VeXpo bill includes indie creators across a wide range: Linvy, Limina Alteri, Amaya Whisper, Hiyori Mokami, Kai Kurayomi. Agency and indie appear on the same programme with the independent act headlining. That's the formula that has been absent from North American conventions like Anime NYC and San Japan, where agency talent headlines and the most-watched English indie creators aren't in the building. In Birmingham next week, it runs by default.

indies.title: Post-VShojo independent tier, one year on: nobody signed with an agency, everybody is still streaming
indies.blurb: VShojo closed in 2025. A year on, the talent that orbited it has not moved to agencies. Dokibird, Shylily, Mint Fantome, Akuma Nihmune, Bao, and Matara Kan are the consistently cited top-tier English independent names in mid-2026 and none have signed agency deals. All are actively streaming. The infrastructure VShojo organized — merch, events, community — now runs through individual creator operations at a scale comparable to what mid-tier agency acts ran two years ago. The predicted mass migration to agencies after VShojo's closure did not materialize. The indie top tier is not in flux, and its convention and merchandise footprint is growing.

indies.title: September debut window: post-convention viewer reset opens the year's second major indie launch window
indies.blurb: August's convention circuit — OffKai, Anime NYC, San Japan — is done. September opens the post-convention viewer reset, the period when audiences returning from summer schedules tend to sample new content. Multiple English-language indie VTubers have debuted or soft-launched in the past week targeting this window, continuing the August trend noted last issue. The tactic is explicit enough in debut-tracking communities that the September reset launch is treated as a named strategy. The class spans YouTube, Twitch, and TikTok with the usual range of production levels. Debut tracking is active on hololist.net.

tea.text: Word on /vt/ is the Filian-to-Phase-Connect theory has crossed from 'leading hypothesis' into 'working assumption.' The math is doing the rounds: Phase Saga loses two members in year one, the one-year anniversary is October 25, Pippa has been doing the 'spoilers' bit on stream for weeks, and filianislost.com is still registered with no Phase 2 trigger. The counter-camp says this is Pippa content and Filian has said before she plans to stay indie. Neither side has anything more solid than inference. The board is running October 25 countdown clocks and the over/under on a Phase Connect announcement before then is the most active thread in the general. Week fourteen, no resolution.

The rumor mill says NIJISANJI EN's Immersion-Focused Male Audition shortlist emails are supposed to go out in the last week of September — the announcement said 'approximately one month' after the August 29 close, putting first contact in the September 26-30 window. /vt/ has the expected new wave hype threads, but the more interesting discussion is about whether the 'immersion-focused' framing means the wave debuts into a pre-built setting. A thread this week claimed shortlisted candidates have already received a 'world introduction' packet. Zero confirmation — standard audition practice does not include pre-contact briefings. The shortlist window opens in three weeks if the timeline holds.

Phase Saga anniversary speculation has three camps and the meta-joke is getting out of hand. Camp one: Phase Connect drops a Gen 4.5 announcement at or before October 25, Filian is the headliner. Camp two: the four remaining Saga members get a quiet anniversary stream week with no surprises. Camp three: Phase Connect says nothing official because the two graduations made the gen a tender subject. The joke all three camps share is that every scenario requires Filian to either be in Phase Connect or explicitly deny it by October 24, and she has done neither. Which camp finds this funniest changes depending on which side you're arguing.

BY THE BEAT's major-label timeline got a second look this week now that the MERORI bilingual rollout is complete and August is over. The community question: is the 2027 Universal Music / Virgin Music major debut still on track, given no milestone update has come from ANYCOLOR since the March 2026 announcement? The 'yes, this is how label development works' camp points to the formal press release and notes six-to-twelve month development gaps are standard before a debut push. The 'soft announcement' camp says the timeline was always hedged. The English MERORI MV still outperforms the Japanese version on view counts. Both camps cite that as evidence for their position.

footerNote: Next signal drops Monday, 14 September — VeXpo opens in Birmingham Thursday night, the MikoMari XRAGE collection goes live Wednesday, the Justice City Groove popup arrives in Costa Mesa on the 20th, and the Phase Saga October 25 clock ticks louder every week. Fourteen weeks on Filian. See you in seven.
